answer: Grow every account like a tree in an orchard: mining weight ripens slowly over seasons of honest participation, and a new tree bears no fruit until it survives three full seasons, so a farm cannot rush a harvest. Each epoch, accounts must complete one line of a sonnet, a fourteen-step staggered proof where each step lands in a different epoch, making bulk creation slow and expensive. Publish an atlas of the endorsement graph: every account's links are mapped publicly, and dense clusters of identical maps are pruned together, so clones betray themselves by their sameness.
